description: Shorting Goldstein's gAIX (a tokenized index fund of AI and tech stock tokens) with USDG, and lending gAIX to the shorts: whether the desk is open or paused (every weekend), gAIX's price, the limit and the room left for new shorts (book ceiling, a tenth of supply, gAIX lent), the rates for shorts and lenders, the bounds on the pool hook's charge. With sell or buy: what selling or buying that much gAIX through Goldstein's pool brings or costs, and the hook's charge. With wallet: its short (gAIX owed, USDG held, limit used, the price at which it can be closed for it), its gAIX in bgAIX and its balances.

buy.description: Optional: gAIX to quote a purchase of (a close), like "5"

sell.description: Optional: gAIX to quote a sale of (an open), like "5"

wallet.description: Optional: a wallet whose short and lending to read (0x...)

name: gaix_short_quote
title: gAIX shorts: the desk, quotes and a wallet's short
